svg.title: Argentina wine-growing study atlas
svg.desc: A focused view follows the wine-growing corridor along the Andes, from high northern valleys to northern Patagonia. Approximate study locations, not appellation boundaries. Numbers refer to the study key; a shared number connects places in one grouped lesson. 1: Salta / Cafayate. Cafayate is a high northern valley within Salta province, south of Salta city. 2: La Rioja. Inland western Argentina, south of Salta and north of San Juan; not the Spanish region of the same name. 3: San Juan. Western Argentina north of Mendoza. 4: Mendoza (Uco, Luján de Cuyo). Mendoza lies east of the Andes; Uco Valley lies south of Luján de Cuyo. 5: Patagonia (Río Negro/Neuquén). Northern Patagonian river-valley vineyards south of Mendoza. These locators do not imply all Patagonia is planted.

g.text: Dots locate representative places · boundaries do not represent appellations
